description: Source code for managing virtual addresses in Bluetooth Mesh, including adding, deleting, retrieving UUIDs, collision checking, and persistent storage handling.

methods.name: va_store
methods.description: Marks a virtual address as changed and schedules storage if enabled.

methods.name: bt_mesh_va_add
methods.description: Adds a new virtual address with a given UUID, or returns existing if already present.

methods.name: bt_mesh_va_del
methods.description: Removes a virtual address identified by UUID.

methods.name: bt_mesh_va_uuid_get
methods.description: Retrieves UUID for a given address, optionally returning the associated address.

methods.name: bt_mesh_va_collision_check
methods.description: Checks for address collision among virtual addresses.

methods.name: bt_mesh_va_find
methods.description: Finds a virtual address entry by UUID.

methods.name: va_get_by_idx
methods.description: Retrieves virtual address entry by index.

methods.name: bt_mesh_va_get_uuid_by_idx
methods.description: Gets UUID of virtual address by index.

methods.name: bt_mesh_va_get_idx_by_uuid
methods.description: Gets index of virtual address by UUID.

methods.name: bt_mesh_va_pending_store
methods.description: Stores pending changes of virtual addresses to persistent storage.
